releaseName: Lokify v1.4.6 – Native Android Google Sign-In, Zero Guest Mode & Direct In-App APK Updater
releaseNotes:
• Native Android Google Account Chooser: Shows user's real Google accounts on the device (like Amazon, Swiggy) with 1-tap sign in.
• Removed Guest Citizen Mode: Clean, secure login experience for citizens and municipal officers.
• Removed All Mock Accounts: Only authentic user Google accounts on the phone.
• Direct In-App Streaming Updater: Streams Lokify.apk in the background and launches package installer automatically.
